items.question: What is an outsourced SDR?
items.answer: An outsourced SDR (Sales Development Representative) is a prospecting salesperson dedicated to your company but employed and managed by Quorexis. They prospect your targets, generate conversations and qualify meetings for your Account Executives.

items.question: What's the difference between Quorexis and a call center?
items.answer: A call center optimizes call volume with standard scripts. Quorexis builds a complete prospecting engine: data, ICP targeting, multichannel, B2B-trained SDRs, business qualification and pipeline measurement — not just call counts.

items.question: What channels do you use?
items.answer: We combine Cold Email, LinkedIn Outreach and Cold Calling in coordinated sequences. The mix depends on your market, your ICP and your preferences.

items.question: How do you define a qualified meeting?
items.answer: A qualified meeting isn't just someone on a calendar. We validate fit with your ICP, existence of a need, contact authority and timing. Exact criteria are defined together during setup.

items.question: Do you work directly in our CRM?
items.answer: Yes, we can integrate with your CRM (HubSpot, Zoho, Saalz, or other). Conversations, qualifications and meetings are documented directly in your system.

items.question: How long does it take to launch a campaign?
items.answer: On average 2 to 3 weeks for the complete setup: strategy, ICP, data, infrastructure, messaging and SDR training. A pilot can start faster on a reduced scope.

items.question: Do your SDRs speak French?
items.answer: Yes, all our SDRs are native francophones or bilingual, perfectly aligned with the French and francophone European market.

items.question: Does Quorexis replace our sales team?
items.answer: No. Quorexis feeds your sales team with opportunities. Your Account Executives focus on what they do best: closing. We handle the top of the funnel.
